prompts.master:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the finished full-body adult fantasy woman with coral bikini-cut underlayer. Image 2 is the user's ORIGINAL reference, used ONLY for the six hanging hip ornaments.
Replace ONLY the small pink-green hanging decorations at both hips of image 1 with a faithful copy of the original-reference ornaments, including their fine chain attachment. Match ONLY the six small dangling hip ornaments in the original mountain reference, not its other clothing or body. They are two groups of THREE individually suspended slender ornaments. Image-left group colors, from left to right: pale yellow-green, soft pink, pale green. Image-right group colors, from left to right: pale green, soft pink, soft pink. These groups are NOT mirrored copies. Every ornament hangs from its own spaced attachment on a hair-thin pale-gold horizontal/very shallow curved beaded waist chain under the hands, not all from one attachment ring. Each has a very long slim continuous neck (about the upper two thirds) widening only near its bottom into a SMALL elongated pear/water-drop bulb, gently tapered tip, subtly uneven hanging lengths. Thin pale leaf-green flat ribbons/long narrow loops descend alongside the narrow necks; the rightmost pink ornament on image-right has a particularly visible green long loop. Small simple attachments, no chunky knots. Pale softly translucent pink-green polished material with restrained highlights, muted saturation. Keep original-reference relative proportions and spacing. No oversized round drops, no bouquet clusters, no big bows, no braided rope, no large metal rings or extra beads. Copy visible ornament details as closely as possible; do not invent ornate jewelry.
On the edit target attach the six separate pendants directly below the hands along the hip line above the coral briefs, with original-reference thin chain sections. Keep their scale natural and delicate relative to the hands and thighs. Replace the existing shared green bow clusters; leave the red briefs' own side ties untouched. Preserve the entire existing face, expression, eyes, hair, head, hands, pose, body proportions, coral opaque briefs, crossed red bodice and higher neckline, gold waist belt and CENTRAL gold chain details, necklace, ivory outer robe, long central red skirt panel, drapes, hem, shoes, lighting, framing and genuine alpha transparency. Do not change any garment cut, coverage or any other object. Full body same 1024x1536 composition; no background, text or watermark.
Precision note: each pendant body visible from neck top to tiny bottom tip is about 4 to 5 times its widest bulb width, not an extremely long 10:1 needle. The three pendants on each side are closely parallel with slight natural height variation. The original mountain reference takes priority over the existing jewelry. Change only the jewelry as instructed.

prompts.masterBase:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Revise the adult woman's fantasy fashion character in image 2, using image 1 for facial likeness and costume colors/accessory craftsmanship. Deliver a complete full-body desktop character asset, centered 1024x1536 portrait, genuine transparent alpha background.
FACE: match image 1's mature adult face age 28, softly oval with tapered chin, small straight nose, relaxed rose lips, slender natural brows and blue-gray eyes looking gently viewer-left. Same dark high half-up bun and loose side wisps, red-bronze hair ornaments and fine chains, subtle reserved expression and minimal makeup.
CLOTHING: retain image 2's fully clothed body proportions and opaque coral-vermilion fitted wrap bodice; improve the crossed fabric tailoring and narrow ivory neckline piping toward image 1, with the neckline ending at the upper sternum. Ivory long-sleeved outer robe and blush-peach shoulder drapes. Replace the closed bell-shaped skirt with a straight multi-panel skirt featuring two side openings and a central coral front panel, BUT add a clearly visible opaque ivory inner skirt from waist to just above the knees. This inner skirt must cover the hips, pelvis and upper thighs completely; side openings show the contrasting ivory fabric above knees and lower legs below knees. This is a layered historical fantasy clothing design with conservative coverage.
ACCESSORIES: faithfully include both left and right hip pendant clusters from image 1. Each cluster is three slender glossy pale-green and pale-pink teardrop jade ornaments hung by light green ribbons. Preserve the gold diamond waist clasp; colored pendants must be visible below the relaxed hands. Retain drop earrings, delicate existing necklace, nude natural nails.
POSE: calm neutral standing fashion catalog pose, hands lightly together at lower waist, three-quarter head facing viewer-left. Full hair, sleeves, skirt and hem inside frame. Long ivory robe falling at outside of legs, subtle flat ivory shoes under hem. Soft neutral diffuse illumination, polished realistic Chinese fantasy animation render, rich fine textile detail. No mountains, scene, text, number, watermark, extra people, painted backdrop or gradient. Transparent background and natural alpha edges.
prompts.pendants: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a standalone six-piece hip ornament accessory; image 2 is its original visual reference, use only the small decorations just below the hands. Correct proportions of the accessory in image 1 to match image 2 more closely: shorten the excessively long narrow necks so EACH entire pendant body from its top to bottom tip is about 4.5 to 5 times its widest bulb width (currently too needle-like, about 8 times). Keep a continuous long slim neck smoothly widening into a modest elongated small pear-shaped base and a tiny pointed tip. Reduce the green ribbon loop widths and lengths to fine, narrow, discreet loops alongside the necks, as in image 2, rather than broad long strips. Keep exact colors: left group green/pink/green, right group green/pink/pink. Keep three INDEPENDENT hanging points on each extremely fine curved gold bead chain, two groups in the same order. Left group's rightmost green hangs a little lower; right group's green hangs a little lower. Soft pale translucent colors tending milky near the bottom, restrained reflection. Preserve no person, no skin, no clothing, no mannequin and genuine transparent background. Full six ornaments isolated product view; do not introduce bows, common attachment rings, ropes or additional ornaments.
prompts.briefs: Use case: product-mockup. Generate a standalone ordinary opaque coral-vermilion bikini bottom, same basic cut as the PLAIN WHITE tie-side bikini bottoms at the upper center-right of image 1. Use only that one plain white swimwear item for construction, not the lace/mesh/thong products elsewhere on this catalogue. Recolor it coral-vermilion to coordinate with image 2's red fantasy dress. Moderately broad triangular front with full opaque front and seat coverage, conventional leg openings, simple narrow straps with tied bows at the left and right sides. Smooth fine satin-like swim fabric with subtle natural folds and neat sewn edges, no sheer material and no exaggerated micro cut. Image 2 shows the intended worn item under the long central dress panel; include only the briefs as an empty garment in this output, no skirt panel, dress, belt, body, hips, skin, mannequin, hands, head, gold jewelry or jade ornaments. Front three-quarter flat product display, single complete garment centered with all ties visible, realistic detailed clothing catalogue rendering, genuine transparent background, no text, no lettering, no watermark.
